title: Can Speech LLMs Recognize When Audio Evidence Is Insufficient? A Diagnostic Study and a Pre-Generation Probing Mitigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29393v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speech large language models are usually evaluated on questions that have answers. We ask what they do when a recording establishes none, and whether the standard way of finding out is sound. Diagnosed on synthesized speech the answer looks clear: Qwen2-Audio fabricates an answer to 92.5% of unanswerable questions, while an ASR cascade reading the same recordings reaches 2.5% hallucination at 6.7% over-refusal, placing the failure in reasoning rather than in perception. The identical protocol on 376 native SQuAD 2.0 questions over human-read recordings removes that conclusion: the cascade hallucinates on 67.7% against the end-to-end model's 69.8%, at a higher over-refusal cost. A paired subset asking the same questions of a synthesized and a human recording of each passage localises the effect in the ASR stage -- the end-to-end model's abstention behaviour does not move with the speaker, the cascade's goes from 11.1% to 65.9%. translated_title: 语音大语言模型能否识别音频证据不足的情况？一项诊断研究与一种生成前探测缓解方法
translated_abstract: 语音大语言模型通常在有答案的问题上进行评估。我们探讨当录音无法为问题提供任何依据时模型会怎么做，以及目前标准的研究方法是否可靠。在合成语音上进行诊断时，结论看似清晰：Qwen2-Audio 对 92.5% 的不可回答问题编造了答案，而读取相同录音的 ASR 级联系统在 6.7% 的过度拒答率下仅产生 2.5% 的幻觉，这似乎将失败归因于推理而非感知。然而，在 376 个基于人工朗读录音的 SQuAD 2.0 原生问题上采用完全相同的评估协议，上述结论被推翻：级联系统产生了 67.7% 的幻觉，而端到端模型为 69.8%，且端到端模型的过度拒答成本更高。通过构建配对子集——对每篇文章的合成录音和人工录音提出相同的问题——该效应被定位于 ASR 阶段：端到端模型的弃答行为不随说话人而变化，而级联系统的弃答率则从 11.1% 升至 65.9%。对……的依赖……（原摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过对比合成语音与真人朗读录音的诊断实验，揭示了语音大语言模型在音频证据不足以回答问题时会大量幻觉作答、且合成语音评估会严重误导失败归因，并提出一种生成前探测方法来缓解该问题。
en_tdlr: This diagnostic study shows that speech LLMs frequently hallucinate answers when audio evidence is insufficient, that synthesized-speech evaluations are misleading for attributing such failures, and proposes a pre-generation probing mitigation.
